axes.model_access: The model family is officially disclosed and routed by tier: release notes (2026-10-07) state Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise use GPT-6 Sol, Free/Go use GPT-6 Luna, and Pro reasoning options use GPT-6 Astra; models are selectable in chat.
axes.runtime: Web, iOS/Android, macOS/Windows desktop apps; all generation and retrieval are processed on OpenAI's cloud — no model runs locally. Desktop quick-chat/screenshot features are just entry points; processing still happens in the cloud.
axes.local_files: Can upload files, images and audio (audio upload per release notes 2026-10-06: transcription, summarization, Q&A); uploaded content is stored in the OpenAI account — ownership and retention are covered by the permissions dimension.
axes.background: Chats return instantly; the Codex Cloud line explicitly says "tasks can continue while your computer sleeps" (release notes 2026-09-29). The chat product itself has no offline-continuation form.
axes.tools: Official connectors (Gmail/Calendar etc.) and partner Apps; built-in feature lines like Slides/Sites/Finances; a separate API line exists. Plugins are disclosed on the Codex line; the consumer chat surface extends mainly via official connectors.
axes.context: Has memory and Projects for organizing history; temporary chats leave no history and build no memory. The full boundary of cross-session memory is per the official help pages.
axes.permissions: Official policy pages: personal services may use chats for model training by default; you can turn this off under "Settings → Data controls" or choose "Don't use my content for training" in the privacy portal; temporary chats are not used for training; Team/Enterprise/API do not train by default (API requires explicit opt-in); for the thumbs up/down feedback you submit, the whole related conversation may still be used for training.
axes.fit: Suits "ask anything a bit" general Q&A and writing, provided you accept cloud processing. For sensitive content, turn off the training switch first or use temporary chat; enterprise data goes through Team/Enterprise/API. For local processing or swappable models, closed cloud assistants like this are not suitable.
